name: Feature Detectors in Scale Space
aliases: Feature Detectors in Scale Space — Laplacian maxima detection
definition: A method to detect blobs by looking at the behavior of derivatives of the scale space along the scale dimension, specifically detecting Laplacian maxima in both scale and space.
summary: Feature Detectors in Scale Space identifies volumetric blobs by finding Laplacian maxima across scales, maintaining full spatial resolution unlike subsampled pyramids to accurately determine feature size and location.
